title: Banana Cat Crying
blurb: A cat in a banana costume, sobbing its small heart out, and somehow one of the most emotionally effective sounds on the internet. The Banana Cat videos work because they commit entirely to the bit: the crying is genuinely distressing, the outfit is genuinely ridiculous, and neither element backs down. That combination produced a whole genre best described as devastating but adorable. Use it for minor injustices, wholesome disappointments, and watching somebody else eat the food you had been thinking about since lunchtime. Nobody is actually upset. Everybody is a bit upset.
origin: From the Banana Cat meme videos: a costumed cat crying dramatically.
